answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 28688 Country: India Title: I heard that the company pepsi and other cold drinks mix pepsin which excrated from pork fat than can we drink this type of liquid Question: I heard that the company pepsi and other cold drinks mix pepsin which excrated from pork fat than can we drink this type of liquid Answer ID: 28688 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 80/80/M=1432) We are not sure whether a thing extracted from pork fat is added in cold drinks. And until it is not sure and known by shariah parameters they cannot be regarded unlawful. Yes, if someone takes care, it is far better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
